chapter.heading: My Strength and Song
chapter.v:
At that
time you will say, “I will praise you, Lord! Though you were angry with me, your anger is over, and now you comfort me.

Look! God
is my salvation! I will trust in him and I won't be afraid! For the Lord is my strength and song, and he has saved me!”

With great
happiness you will take water from the well of salvation.

At that
time you will say: “Praise the Lord, shout out his name! Tell the nations what he has done—let them know of his wonderful character!

Sing to
the Lord for all the glorious things he's done—let the whole world know!

Shout loudly
and sing for joy, you people of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great, and is among you.”
